_comment: Copy this to real-league.json and fill in your ACTUAL league — find every value here on Yahoo's League > Settings page in your browser, no API needed.
name: My League Name
_scoring_comment: Only include the stat keys your league actually uses non-default points for. Omit a key to use the standard full-PPR default. Common keys below — delete any you don't need to change.
_rosterSlots_comment: One entry per slot type, in the order Yahoo shows them under League > Settings > Roster Positions. W/R/T = FLEX, Q/W/R/T = SUPERFLEX. BN = bench (not a starting slot).
